F1: KEEP — the range effect's dependency array is only `[mount.ready, chart, range]` and `addSeries` mutates just `seriesCountRef`, so the Context range already present at mount stays silently unapplied after the first series is added, contradicting the documented "activates on the first addSeries" behavior; the translation test masks this by calling `setRange` after `addSeries`, which is the only thing that actually re-runs the effect.
